description: David asked to clean up the One Texas H1 2026 Scorecard slide by removing artifacts/extraneous data. Chase (sub-agent) deleted 41 redundant shapes but did not resize or reposition the remaining shapes to fill the slide. David's feedback: it just shrank the content and made it less readable, leaving dead whitespace where the deleted column used to be.
correction: Removing clutter from a slide is not just deletion, it requires reflowing what remains so the layout still fills the canvas and reads as an intentional design, not a slide with a hole in it. Any slide-cleanup task must include a resize/reposition pass on the kept elements as a mandatory final step, not an optional nice-to-have.
systemic_fix: When instructing an agent to clean up a slide/deck, explicitly require a layout re-flow step after content removal: kept shapes must be resized and repositioned to use the full slide area, not left at their original size and position with empty space where deleted content used to be.
